description: Source file implementing a PyTorch FX graph transformation that merges multiple matrix multiplication operations sharing the same right-hand side operand into a single larger matrix multiplication for optimization. Contains functions to split merged results, analyze dependencies, and perform the merge transformation.

methods.name: tuple[torch.Tensor,...] split_result_tensors( result: torch.Tensor, inputs: list[torch.Tensor] )
methods.description: Splits the merged matrix multiplication result tensor into individual results corresponding to each input tensor.

methods.name: may_depend_on(a: Node, b: Node, search_depth: int = 6)
methods.description: Determines if one FX graph node may depend on another, considering indirect dependencies up to a specified depth.

methods.name: are_nodes_independent(nodes: list[Node])
methods.description: Checks if a list of FX graph nodes are pairwise data independent.

methods.name: merge_matmul(in_mod: torch.nn.Module)
methods.description: Performs a graph transformation that merges multiple matrix multiplication nodes sharing the same RHS operand into a single, larger matmul for efficiency.

ctags.name: may_depend_on
ctags.pattern: /^def may_depend_on(a: Node, b: Node, search_depth: int = 6):$/
